ValidationRule.description: Account has a restricted country. Cannot create Server Deployment
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), Account__r.Country_Exception_Approved__c = FALSE, TEXT(Account__r.Type) = 'Prospect', OR( TEXT(Account__r.Country_Restrictions__c) = 'Restricted', TEXT(Account__r.Country_Restrictions__c) = 'Embargo or DNS' ), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Server Deployment Account currently has a selected country that is restricted. Please first submit a Restricted Country Exception ISR request at the account level. Once fully approved, the Server Deployment can be created.
